rotating_tips: Message with @name or #group — tap a chat row to focus a target
@ai your question — PointChat AI (only your private AI thread)
/location — share position (pick @ or # first, or use focused chat)
Voice notes: ±1s buttons and waveform tap to seek
Type @ to see people; type / for slash commands
ai_knowledge: PointChat supports DMs (@username), groups (#groupname), voice messages, photos/files, and /location. /newbot Name opens creating a custom bot. @ai followed by a message talks to PointChat AI only in the user's private self-chat thread (participants are the same user twice in the database). Custom bots reply automatically when messaged. Slash commands: /myprofile, /setting, /location, /newbot. Users usually need an @ or # target or a focused chat before sending normal messages; slash commands and @ai do not use the focused DM target.
